newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spain's Caja Madrid launches Repsol deposit.
newsitem.headline: Spain's Caja Madrid launches Repsol deposit.

text.p: Spanish savings bank Caja de Madrid said on Monday it is launching a deposit whose yield is referenced to Repsol's share price performance on the stock market, but is 100 percent guaranteed.
The Repsol bourse deposit, "Deposito Bolsa Repsol", offers 75 percent of the average monthly revaluation of the shares during the 18 months' maturity of the deposit.
Caja de Madrid said it was launching the product after the last privatisation of the petrochemical company in April was strongly oversubscribed.
